label: R86 netifd diagnostic: missing valid child-reaping check
limitations: This netifd matrix lacks complete evidence for finished hotplug callbacks, reaped children checked through proc status PPid, and stable child CPU before queries. Timings/CPU are retained for diagnosis, not acceptance; rerun with the complete initialization gate.
method: Medians of per-run statistics; c4 CPU uses one outer interval divided by successful plus warm-up operations. c4 outer throughput includes warm-up/startup and uses /proc/uptime resolution. Client validation runs on the same router CPUs.
